reason: Round 3 (spec 13): two routes on the twelve raw features, added so that outcomes land near the floor. In rounds 1 and 2 every route reached the floor, because agents read each other's results and built the interaction into every method, so no settled outcome was near the threshold and none was refuted. These routes forbid that in their method: no products, kernels, feature selection or other constructed features. Before declaring them, the map's author measured each on three pilot-sized samples scored on 200,000 rows from the generator: a default random forest 0.812 (0.800 on the pilot sample itself; tuned, 0.846, which is why this route fixes the defaults), k-nearest neighbours with k tuned in cross-validation 0.791. The logistic route stays open as declared (0.626). A credit on these routes that breaks its method rule is declined by judgment. Nothing else changes.
